name: RENAME_TABLE_BASIC
description: ALTER TABLE RENAME TO renames the table; data is preserved

name: RENAME_COLUMN_BASIC
description: ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN updates the schema sql
expected_stdout:
1|x
CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER, bb TEXT)

name: ADD_COLUMN_NOT_NULL_DEFAULT
description: ADD COLUMN with NOT NULL DEFAULT populates existing rows

name: DROP_COLUMN_BASIC
description: ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN removes the column and its data (3.35+)
expected_stdout:
1|5
CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER, c INTEGER)

name: ADD_COLUMN_WITH_FK_REFERENCE
description: ADD COLUMN may declare REFERENCES into another table

name: ADD_COLUMN_WITH_CHECK_ENFORCED
description: ADD COLUMN with CHECK constraint rejects out-of-range inserts

name: RENAME_COLUMN_REWRITES_VIEW
description: RENAME COLUMN rewrites referencing views' stored sql
expected_stdout: CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT a, bb FROM t

name: RENAME_COLUMN_REWRITES_TRIGGER
description: RENAME COLUMN rewrites NEW.col references in dependent triggers
expected_stdout: CREATE TRIGGER trg AFTER INSERT ON t BEGIN SELECT NEW.bb; END

name: RENAME_TABLE_REWRITES_VIEW_REF
description: RENAME TABLE updates view references to the new (quoted) name
expected_stdout: CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT * FROM "tt"

name: RENAME_TABLE_REWRITES_TRIGGER_REF
description: RENAME TABLE updates trigger ON-clause to the new (quoted) table name
expected_stdout: CREATE TRIGGER tr AFTER INSERT ON "tt" BEGIN SELECT NEW.b; END

name: DROP_COLUMN_USED_BY_INDEX_ERRORS
description: DROP COLUMN that is referenced by an index errors at apply time
expected_stderr_contains: error in index idx_t_b after drop column: no such column: b

name: SCHEMA_VERSION_INCREMENTS_ON_ALTER
description: schema_version increments on each ALTER (visible across operations)

name: LEGACY_ALTER_TABLE_NO_VIEW_REWRITE
description: PRAGMA legacy_alter_table=1 skips rewriting view body on RENAME TABLE
expected_stdout: CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT * FROM t

name: ALTER_ADD_COLUMN_ON_STRICT_TABLE
description: ALTER ADD COLUMN works on STRICT tables; sql keeps STRICT suffix
expected_stdout:
1|x|NULL
CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER, b TEXT, c INTEGER) STRICT

name: ALTER_ADD_COLUMN_ON_WITHOUT_ROWID
description: ALTER ADD COLUMN with DEFAULT works on WITHOUT ROWID tables
expected_stdout:
1|x|7
CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, b TEXT, c INTEGER DEFAULT 7) WITHOUT ROWID

name: RENAME_COLUMN_PRESERVES_DATA
description: RENAME COLUMN preserves existing row data under the new column name

name: ADD_COLUMN_DEFAULT_FILLS_EXISTING_ROWS
description: ADD COLUMN with DEFAULT applies the default to existing rows

name: DROP_LAST_COLUMN_ERROR
description: DROP COLUMN refuses to remove the last remaining column
expected_stderr_contains: cannot drop column "a": no other columns exist
